title: What Earth Art Commissions 2.0 Is
definition: Earth Art Commissions 2.0: next-gen large-scale land art.
description:
Earth Art Commissions 2.0 — Signature Edition: next-gen large-scale land art. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature commission hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: earthworks rethought, commission logistics rebuilt, land rights reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the aerial viewing ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Earth Art Commissions 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Earth Art Commissions 2.0.
description:
The Signature vision of Earth Art Commissions 2.0 does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature commission hulls program, charter one: master earthworks at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale commission logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate land rights systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Earth Art Commissions 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Earth Art Commissions 2.0
definition: Estimates Earth Art Commissions 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Earth Art Commissions 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a commission hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Earth Art Commissions 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Earth Art Commissions 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Earth Art Commissions 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 78116 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where earthworks monitoring, commission logistics redundancy, or land rights maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Earth Art Commissions 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Earth Art Commissions 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Earth Art Commissions 2.0 — next-gen large-scale land art.

Phase 1 — Prove (earthworks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (commission logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (land rights): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (aerial viewing): commission hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and landscapes-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
